title: Rust: finish in-flight PrefixDelegations and wire authorization gate into root DAO ingest
description: The working tree has uncommitted, non-compiling in-flight work implementing the spec 8.7.2 delegation table (rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs +137 lines: UnauthorizedPrefixReason{DefaultRoute,ForeignPrefix}, PrefixAuthorizationError, PrefixDelegations keyed by pubkey, MAX_PREFIX_DELEGATIONS=64) left by another session. Tasks: (1) fix E0502 borrow conflict at routing.rs:219-224 (self.len() while entry mutably borrowed); (2) wire PrefixAuthorizationError screening into DaoManager::process_signature_verified_inner (routing.rs:489-596) so every canonical Target is authorized against the authenticated origin BEFORE staged mutation and replay-floor commit (routing.rs:573); (3) accept sub-/128 delegated Targets by relaxing the Target-option data-length==18 profile only when a delegation authorizes it (wire profile today: rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs:470-476); keep /0 failing closed. Note: rust/lichen-rpl/tests/rpl_route_state_vectors.rs is currently broken at HEAD by the parallel ow1e.111 Ipv6Addr migration - coordinate. Acceptance: delegation allow-row (delegated prefix -> Applied) plus the existing deny matrix in rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs all pass; cargo test -p lichen-rpl, fmt, clippy -D warnings clean. Decomposed from project-LICHEN-2auf.44.9.2.
